performance.calculatedHere: Calculated by MyNetaji, not published as a figure by the source.
performance.releasedNotPublished: Funds released is not published per MP under the current MPLADS fund-flow, so it is left blank rather than shown as zero.
performance.unclassifiedWorks: {{count}} works carry a stage we haven't mapped to a status, so they're counted in the total only.
performance.noWorks: No MPLADS works are on record for this MP yet.
performance.noDevelopmentData: No MPLADS development record is available for this MP yet. That's a gap in the published data, not a record of nothing being done.
performance.noCommitteeData: Committee memberships aren't available from a machine-readable official source yet, so none are shown.
performance.noParliamentData: No parliamentary activity record is available for this MP yet.
performance.promisesHint: Only commitments with cited evidence for their status are shown.
performance.unverifiedPromises: {{count}} recorded commitments have no verified status yet.
performance.noPromises: No promise tracking is on record for this MP yet. Whether a commitment was kept needs cited evidence, so nothing is shown until that evidence exists — this is not a finding that no promises were made or kept.
performance.transparencyHint: From the same election affidavit shown elsewhere on this profile.
performance.noTransparencyData: No election affidavit is on file for this MP yet.
performance.mpOnly: Performance data is currently available for Members of Parliament only.
performance.empty: No performance record is available for this MP yet.
performance.footnote: Figures come from the sources named beside each metric and are refreshed as those sources publish. Blank means the source doesn't publish it — never that the value is zero. MyNetaji does not rate or rank politicians.
performance.mpladsNote: MPLADS is a constituency development budget. Funds are released to the district authority and spent on works the MP recommends; none of it is money received by the MP.
performance.affidavitNote: Declared in the candidate's election affidavit. Assets and liabilities are as declared at the time of that election, not a current valuation.
